title: Three Summers and One Short Path
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：health　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 health 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the coach ① built the health that no runner in the park would have measured, and he said the building was the whole of the summer. The ② health, meaning the strength itself and not the path, ran three summers and stayed unmeasured in the book; health, he said, is the only thing in a park that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ kind of health in that park had the same short path beside it, and the ④ health at the far gate, meaning the fitness they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Health, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the coach said the measuring is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the health was the whole of the matter, meaning the wellbeing and not the strength. The ⑥ health, meaning the wellbeing and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; health, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both strength and a wellbeing. He said the wellbeing is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ health had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short path. The ⑧ health of the whole thing, the coach wrote in June, was one park and three summers of measuring; health, he said, is either the fitness at the far gate or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ health I remember is the health measured in the log, which closed in 1979 and is still measured as the quietest in the park. ⑩ Health, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all health, she said, is a wellbeing that has agreed to look like strength. She said the wellbeing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 健康；身体状况（指公园里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 健康；身体状况（指那分体力本身，与小路相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the health 增进健康
D. n. 健康；身体状况（指留给孩子们守住的那一分）
E. n. 康健（抽象总称，指一处公园的健康之事）
F. n. 健康；身体状况（指日志里写到、被量过的的那一分）
G. n. 康乐、福祉（指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 福祉（抽象总称，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the health that no runner in the park would have measured
The health, meaning the strength itself and not the path
Every kind of health in that park
the health at the far gate
the health was the whole of the matter
the health had become a line in a log
The health of the whole thing

answers.why: build the health 意为“增进健康”，1972 年那位教练把公园里没有一位跑者肯衡量的健康做了一遍。
health 意为“健康；身体状况”，指那分体力本身而不是小路，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被衡量。
health 意为“健康；身体状况”，指公园里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一条短短的小径。
health 意为“健康；身体状况”，指最远那道门口留给孩子们守住的那一分，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
health 意为“康乐、福祉”，指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份康乐就是那件事的全部。
health 意为“福祉”，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分体力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
health 意为“健康；身体状况”，指日志里写到、被量过的的那一分，到 1977 年这一分成了日志里的一行。
health 意为“康健”，教练六月写道，整件事的健康之事是一处公园和三个夏天的衡量。
health 意为“健康；身体状况”，我记得的是日志里衡量过的那一分，1979 年停记了，至今仍被说成公园里最安静的一分。
health 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，健康是唯一会因为被好好衡量而变得更好的体力。
